$comment: The metric catalogue (SPEC-007 §6.1-§6.6; EP-008 M4(a)). Exactly 42 metric families, one entry each, with type, unit, labels, owner service and a one-line meaning. A metric name or label not declared here is rejected at registration (§6.1: 'Unregistered metric names are rejected by the metrics registration check and fail lint'). The names and label sets are transcribed from §6.3-§6.5 verbatim; nothing is invented and nothing is renamed. MEASURED BY THE MILESTONE: `grep -c '"name"' config/metrics/catalogue.json` prints 42, one per family, so the count cannot drift from the entries.
spec: SPEC-007 §6 (metrics), §6.1 (namespace, types, units), §6.2 (label cardinality and privacy), §6.3 (effectiveness), §6.4 (truth-state counters), §6.5 (quality, cost, provider, DLP, readiness, SLO, HTTP)
label_namespace_note: A SPECIFICATION CONFLICT, RECORDED RATHER THAN RESOLVED SILENTLY. §6.1 lists fourteen canonical label names (environment, tenant_class, truth_state, transition_id, channel, source_class, recipe_id, provider, outcome, severity, dependency_key, egress_class, rule_class, window) and says no other label name is permitted without a specification change. §6.3-§6.5 then declare, per metric, labels that are NOT in that list: component, ci, reappearance_window, verification_method, reason_code, gate_kind, currency, auth_mode, budget_key, sink, data_class, objective, direction, service, layer, detection_path, path_distinct, has_verification_reference, workflow_name, state, route, method, status_class. Both lists are specification text. This catalogue therefore treats the per-metric tables as the declaration of the label set and §6.1's list as the privacy-critical subset, validates every label against the UNION of both, and refuses any label declared nowhere in SPEC-007 — which is the property that matters: a metric cannot invent a label. A specification change should add §6.1 to the list or move the others into it, and this note is the finding for that change.

per_family_label_value_sets.$comment: LABEL VALUE SETS THAT ARE BOUNDED PER METRIC RATHER THAN GLOBALLY (EP-008 M5, closing a gap the readiness work recorded). SPEC-007 §6.3-§6.5 bound reason_code PER METRIC - each metric row declares its own enum - and the registry could not enforce a bound it could not see, so an out-of-enum reason code was accepted at record time. This section carries those bounds where the row declares one; a family absent from it still names its source in label_value_set_sources, and the remaining families are owed.

label_value_set_sources.$comment: §6.2 prohibits a label whose value set is not a bounded enum. Every remaining label's bound is named here rather than left implicit: four are open identifiers whose bound is the versioned data that issues them, and reason_code is bounded PER METRIC by the enum in its own §6.3-§6.5 row.
label_value_set_sources.reason_code: the per-metric enum in the family's own SPEC-007 §6.3-§6.5 row
label_value_set_sources.recipe_id: the signed RemovalRecipe registry (VG-CHANNEL-003), which issues recipe identifiers
label_value_set_sources.provider: the declared provider set of SPEC-000 §8
label_value_set_sources.route: the declared route templates in the route registry (SPEC-003); never a resolved path
label_value_set_sources.workflow_name: the declared workflow set of SPEC-001 §7

families.name: vanishgraph_removal_effectiveness_events_total
families.meaning: Raw effectiveness event counts; the two exclusion components are mandatory so exclusions are visible and never silent (SPEC-007 §6.3).

families.name: vanishgraph_removal_effectiveness_ratio
families.meaning: Wilson score interval at 95% confidence over the raw counters, emitted with ci in point, lower, upper, and never emitted without its denominator (SPEC-007 §6.3).

families.name: vanishgraph_truth_state_transitions_total
families.meaning: Truth-state transitions by DESTINATION state and transition id; has_verification_reference exists so a VERIFIED_REMOVED transition without an observation is detectable rather than invisible (SPEC-007 §6.4, alert A-01b).

families.name: vanishgraph_truth_state_current
families.meaning: Current exposures per truth state, used for backlog and never for success (SPEC-007 §6.4).

families.name: vanishgraph_truth_state_illegal_transition_refused_total
families.meaning: Refusals of a transition the state machine forbids: a control signal, not noise (SPEC-007 §6.4).

families.name: vanishgraph_reappearance_events_total
families.meaning: VERIFIED_REMOVED to REAPPEARED transitions, bucketed by time since removal (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_reappearance_rate_ratio
families.meaning: Reappearances divided by verified removals in the window, with the denominator series required alongside (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_verification_lag_seconds
families.meaning: ACKNOWLEDGED to VerificationObservation recorded; buckets 1h, 6h, 24h, 72h, 7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, +Inf (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_false_positive_events_total
families.meaning: Assessments believed to be a subject match that were later disproved or rejected, by classified reason (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_false_positive_rate_ratio
families.meaning: False positives divided by MATCH_CONFIRMED transitions in the window, denominator required alongside (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_stale_recipe_refusals_total
families.meaning: Stale, unsigned or disabled RemovalRecipe use refused (VG-CHANNEL-003; SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_recipe_freshness_age_seconds
families.meaning: Age of the loaded recipe set; drives the stale-recipe alert A-04 (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_action_ambiguity_events_total
families.meaning: Ambiguous external results by classified cause (VG-ACTION-002; SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_reconciliation_events_total
families.meaning: Reconciliation attempts and their results; UNRESOLVED and DUPLICATE_EFFECT_DETECTED are alertable (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_reconciliation_lag_seconds
families.meaning: Ambiguity detected to reconciliation resolved; buckets 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 24h, 72h, +Inf (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_human_minutes_total
families.meaning: Human time consumed resolving HumanGate steps, recorded when the gate is resolved and never estimated per attempt (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_external_action_cost_minor_units_total
families.meaning: Real spend for external effects in integer minor units with an explicit currency; a float cost or an implicit currency is refused (SPEC-001 §2 Money; SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_source_channel_health_status
families.meaning: Probe-derived transport health: 0 UNKNOWN, 1 HEALTHY, 2 DEGRADED, 3 UNAVAILABLE; never set by an optimistic default (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_provider_auth_failures_total
families.meaning: Auth failures at a provider transport by classified cause (ADR-004 official transports only; SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_source_ratelimit_saturation_ratio
families.meaning: Observed request rate divided by the configured per-source limit from versioned rate-limit data; a value at or above 1.0 means refusal by policy was required (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_source_ratelimit_refusals_total
families.meaning: Client-side rate-limit refusals are the intended behaviour and are counted separately from provider-side throttling (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_action_budget_consumption_ratio
families.meaning: Consumed divided by allowed effect budget, by budget key (VG-ACTION-005; SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_action_budget_refusals_total
families.meaning: Refusals to write because a budget was exhausted: the external effect did not happen (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_dlp_scrub_outcome_total
families.meaning: Every scrub decision by sink and outcome; DENIED and FAILED must both be alertable (SPEC-007 §6.5, alert A-06).

families.name: vanishgraph_dlp_redactions_total
families.meaning: Redactions applied, classified by EgressClass and rule class; never carries the redacted value or a hash of it (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_dlp_egress_denied_total
families.meaning: Denied egress events; IDENTITY_DOCUMENT and AUTH_SECRET denials are security-relevant (SPEC-007 §6.5, alerts A-06/A-06b).

families.name: vanishgraph_dlp_canary_detections_total
families.meaning: Non-zero is a critical defect: a canary reached a sink (SPEC-007 §6.5, alert A-06c).

families.name: vanishgraph_telemetry_egress_failures_total
families.meaning: Dropped telemetry by classified reason; dropping is honest, fabricating a substitute record is not (SPEC-007 §6.5, alert A-11).

families.name: vanishgraph_readiness_status
families.meaning: 0 NOT_READY, 1 READY, one series per declared dependency plus an overall series (SPEC-007 §6.5, §7).

families.name: vanishgraph_dependency_probe_duration_seconds
families.meaning: Probe latency, used for probe-timeout diagnosis (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_dependency_probe_failures_total
families.meaning: Probe failures by cause so on-call can act rather than guess (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_readiness_state_changes_total
families.meaning: Readiness transitions by direction; drives the readiness-flapping alert A-10 (SPEC-007 §6.5, §7.4).

families.name: vanishgraph_workflow_lag_seconds
families.meaning: Time cases spend in a state before the next transition, with sub-second buckets up to 30 days (SPEC-007 §6.5).

families.name: vanishgraph_duplicate_external_effect_events_total
families.meaning: Non-zero means a second external effect occurred for one IdempotencyKey (VG-ACTION-001; SPEC-007 §6.5, alert A-08).

families.name: vanishgraph_tenant_scope_refusals_total
families.meaning: Cross-tenant access refusals by the layer that refused them (VG-TENANT-002; SPEC-007 §6.5, alert A-05).

families.name: vanishgraph_verification_observations_recorded_total
families.meaning: VerificationObservation records written; path_distinct false is a violation rather than an observation (VG-VERIFY-001; SPEC-007 §6.5, alert A-13).

families.name: vanishgraph_telemetry_deletions_total
families.meaning: Retention and deletion job outcomes; deletion is never silent (SPEC-007 §6.5, §11.2).

families.name: vanishgraph_slo_verdict
families.meaning: 0 INCONCLUSIVE, 1 PASS, 2 FAIL, one series per objective; an absent series is INCONCLUSIVE and is alertable (SPEC-007 §6.5, §9, alert A-15).

families.name: vanishgraph_slo_bad_events_total
families.meaning: Observed bad events in the objective window (SPEC-007 §6.5, §9).

families.name: vanishgraph_slo_allowed_bad_events
families.meaning: One minus the objective expressed as allowed bad events: the error budget (SPEC-007 §6.5, §9).

families.name: vanishgraph_slo_error_budget_burn_ratio
families.meaning: Bad events observed divided by bad events allowed; consumed by alert A-14 (SPEC-007 §6.5, §9).

families.name: vanishgraph_server_http_served_total
families.meaning: Inbound HTTP responses served, excluding readiness and liveness probe traffic; route is the declared template and never a resolved path containing an identifier. This is about HTTP serving only and is never presented as external-effect volume (SPEC-007 §6.5).
